lines.en: label wakanaspring8:
scene sky
Another sunny morning, another reason to pull the curtain closed.
lines.zh: 又一个晴朗的早晨，又一个把窗帘拉上的理由。

lines.en: That sort of mantra had become commonplace for Wakana Watabe. But today, she’d chant it to herself from behind the desk of a friend rather than her own.
lines.zh: 这套说辞对渡部 Wakana 来说早就成了日常。但今天，她是坐在一个朋友的办公桌后面默念它的，而不是自己的。

lines.en: The reason for this was complicated as a feeling, but quite simple as a concept once pressed into the 2.54cm horizontal margins of a notebook.
lines.zh: 作为感受，这背后的原因很复杂；可一旦压进笔记本那 2.54 厘米宽的横向页边距里，作为概念它又相当简单。

lines.en: The last room carried memories of her. Memories of midday trysts and scattered personal effects stored for later use or consumption.
lines.zh: 原来那个房间留着她的痕迹。留着正午幽会的痕迹，还有那些随手扔着、等着日后取用或消耗的私人物件。

lines.en: It was never meant to be that way. Wakana Watabe cared deeply about her career, contrary to popular belief.
lines.zh: 本来不该变成那样的。和大家的印象相反，渡部 Wakana 是很在乎自己这份职业的。

lines.en: But she cared deeply about other things too. And she was always much worse at suppressing her wants and needs than people gave her credit for.
lines.zh: 可她也在乎别的东西。而且在压抑自己的欲望和需求这件事上，她一直比别人以为的差得多。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene1
Right now, for example — she was muttering profanities under her breath as her morning routine was constantly interrupted by two other women she {i}normally{/i} enjoyed the company of.
lines.zh: 比如现在——她正低声咒骂着，因为她的晨间例行被另外两个她{i}平时{/i}其实挺喜欢作伴的女人不断打断。

lines.en: {size=-2}It was hard to enjoy anything at the moment, though. And it certainly didn’t help that they kept talking about things like love and sex when such concepts had been all but stripped from Wakana’s life as of late.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}但眼下什么事都享受不起来。而且她们不停聊着爱与性这种话题，偏偏这些概念最近几乎已从 Wakana 的生活里被剥得一干二净，这更是火上浇油。{/size}

lines.en: And yes, she may have still shared a bed with she who ushered in this sudden apocalypse, but it felt more like it was made of nails than whatever it is beds are normally made of.
lines.zh: 是，她也许还跟那个一手掀起这场突如其来的末日的女人同床共枕，可那张床感觉更像是用钉子做的，而不是床通常该有的材料。

lines.en: No late night talks or sporadic groping sessions when one would wake up before the other. No facing one another before drifting off to sleep.
lines.zh: 没有谁比谁先醒时的深夜长谈，也没有零散的动手动脚。没有入睡前面对面看着彼此。

lines.en: Just a bed that fits two — wide enough so they never have to touch outside of their dreams.
lines.zh: 只有一张能睡两个人的床——宽到她们除了在梦里，永远不必碰到对方。

lines.en: : So you’re just...sending him nudes now? Out of nowhere? For no reason?
lines.zh: : 所以你就这么……突然给他发裸照了？无缘无故？

lines.en: : I figured it would be best if I just confessed that to you now as opposed to them being leaked online and you finding out the way my parents did the first time that happened to me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不如现在就跟你坦白，总好过哪天泄漏到网上，让你像我爸妈头一回撞见时那样发现。

lines.en: : Your parents...saw your nudes?
lines.zh: : 你爸妈……看过你的裸照？

lines.en: : And I saw {i}my{/i} daughter’s. Then, one day, Rin will see {i}her{/i} daughter’s. And the cycle will go on and on until there are no daughters left to send nudes to anyone.
lines.zh: : 而我看了{i}我{/i}女儿的。然后有一天，Rin 会看到{i}她{/i}女儿的。这个循环会一直转下去，直到再没有女儿可以给别人发裸照为止。

lines.en: : And for this reason, I ask that you forgive me. I promise it’s only until someone other than Akira is willing to have sex with me.
lines.zh: : 因为这个原因，我请求你原谅我。我保证，这只是暂时的——等有 Akira 以外的人愿意跟我上床就好了。

lines.en: : Must this really be discussed {i}here{/i} of all places? I have tests to finish grading and you’re about to disrupt the whole process by causing me to spill my breakfast all over them.
lines.zh: : 这种事非得在{i}这儿{/i}谈吗？我还有卷子要改，你们再这么闹下去，我就要把早餐全吐在上面，整个流程都被你们打断了。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene2
: Funny story, actually. It’s that exact thing that ultimately led to me getting boned in the first place. That never would’ve happened at all if Imani didn’t throw up.
lines.zh: : 说起来挺好笑的。当初正是这类事最终让我被睡了。要是 Imani 没吐，根本不会有那一出。

lines.en: : So it’s {i}my{/i} fault you slept with Senpai. Got it.
lines.zh: : 所以是{i}我{/i}害你跟前辈睡的。明白了。

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, though, was it my fault it happened the following morning too?
lines.zh: : 不过我好奇，第二天早上又来一次，也是我的错吗？

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene3
: Never would have happened if you didn’t leave to buy us all water.
lines.zh: : 你要是没出去给大家买水，根本不会发生。

lines.en: : So what I’m hearing is I just need to supervise both you {i}and{/i} Senpai at all times and that this is going to {i}keep{/i} happening if I just leave you two alone.
lines.zh: : 那我听到的意思是，我得时时刻刻盯着你{i}和{/i}前辈，只要我把你俩单独留下，这种事就会{i}一直{/i}发生。

lines.en: : Woah, weird. That’s exactly what Rie’s mom said to me when we first started dating. And it’s just as true now as it was back then.
lines.zh: : 哇，好怪。我和 Rie 刚在一起时她妈就是这么跟我说的。现在跟当年一样成立。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene4
: Again! Why must you do this {i}here?!{/i} I am clearly busy!
lines.zh: : 又来了！你们非得在{i}这儿{/i}说这个吗？！我明明很忙！

lines.en: : Why must {i}you{/i} do this here? You have your own office, girl. Why you gotta be encroaching on mine?
lines.zh: : 你非得在这儿说这个？你有{i}自己{/i}的办公室啊，姑娘。干嘛非要占我的？

lines.en: : I wish I had an office. Or even a closet. I normally just hang out near the ropes since that’s all Akira showed me during orientation.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想有间办公室。哪怕是储物间也行。平时我就在天台那堆绳子附近晃，因为 Akira 入职培训时就给我指了那儿。

lines.en: : This is not {i}your{/i} office either, Imani. It’s Arakawa’s. And until you have the balls to admit to the front office that he isn’t ever showing up again, it’s going to {i}stay{/i} that way.
lines.zh: : 这也不是{i}你的{/i}办公室，Imani。这是荒川的。除非你有种去跟校办承认他再也不会来了，否则它就{i}一直{/i}是他的。

lines.en: : I don’t want to rat Senpai out, though! If you want his office so much, {i}you{/i} do it.
lines.zh: : 可我不想出卖前辈啊！你这么想要他的办公室，你{i}自己{/i}去说。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene5

: Do you think they’ll give {i}me{/i} the office if I do it? Oh! Do teachers work like shogun? Will ousting Akira create a succession crisis where we all have to fight over his office? That sounds fun!
lines.zh: : 我要是去说了，他们会给{i}我{/i}那间办公室吗？哦！老师们是像将军那样干的吗？把 Akira 赶下台会不会引发继承危机，然后大家为了他的办公室打起来？听起来好有趣！

lines.en: : All I’m saying is that I would like some peace and quiet...and that the two of you are more than welcome to use {i}my{/i} office if you want to keep talking about fucking the shogun.
lines.zh: : 我只是想要点清静……还有，你俩要是想继续聊怎么睡那个将军，尽管用{i}我的{/i}办公室。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene6
: I don’t think we should refer to Senpai as “the shogun.” The last thing he needs is more fodder for his power-dynamic kink and I’m pretty sure that’d do it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们不该管前辈叫「将军」。他最不需要的就是再给他那套权力关系的性癖添柴，我敢说这绝对会。

lines.en: : As someone who has only had fully conscious sex with him one time, I did not know about this kink. What other secrets do you know that I definitely won’t take advantage of?
lines.zh: : 作为只跟他有过一次性清醒性行为的人，我不知道他有这癖好。你还知道什么我绝对不会拿来利用的秘密？

lines.en: : Just borrow the school uniform I bought and find out for yourself.
lines.zh: : 借我买的那套校服自己去试不就知道了。

lines.en: : I don’t need to. I stole one of Rin’s when I wanted to feel young again and it fits me surprisingly well.
lines.zh: : 不用借。我为了找回年轻的感觉偷了 Rin 一件，穿在我身上意外地合身。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene7
: Well, that definitely isn’t foreshadowing a future sex scene or anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这绝对不是在给未来的性爱场面埋伏笔什么的。

lines.en: : Hey! Maybe we can {i}both{/i} wear uniforms the next time we have a threesome with Akira! That sounds fun! We can even buy one for him and then we can {i}all{/i} be young again!
lines.zh: : 嘿！下次我们跟 Akira 玩三人行时可以{i}一起{/i}穿校服！听起来好玩！我们还能给他也买一套，然后大家{i}一起{/i}重回年轻！

lines.en: : I’m still in my twenties. Don’t lump me in with you guys yet.
lines.zh: : 我才二十多岁。别急着把我跟你们归到一块儿。

lines.en: : Sorry. I just haven’t done anything sexual with a kouhai since high school.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是高中以后就没跟学妹做过什么了。

lines.en: : I’m your senpai technically. I worked here way before you.
lines.zh: : 严格说我才是你前辈。我比你早来这儿工作多了。

lines.en: : Oh, whoops. That doesn’t change much, though. I haven’t done anything sexual with a senpai since high school either.
lines.zh: : 哦，失敬。不过这没多大区别。我高中以后也没跟前辈做过什么。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene8
: For the love of fucking god/God/{s}GOD{/s}, if you’re going to stand there and ruin my morning, could you at least have the courtesy to talk about something {i}else?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 看在他妈的老天／上帝／GOD 的份上，你们要站在这儿毁我的早晨，能不能行行好{i}换个话题{/i}？！

lines.en: : Because, as you may have heard, my love-life is in fucking {i}shambles{/i} and the last thing I need is to hear about how much sex the two of {i}you{/i} are having while {i}I{/i} am having none!
lines.zh: : 因为，你们可能听说了，我的感情生活他妈的已经{i}一塌糊涂{/i}，我最不需要的就是听{i}你{/i}俩讲你们有多性福，而{i}我{/i}一次都没有！

lines.en: : Wait, {i}none?{/i} But you guys are still living together, aren’t you? I thought the whole proposal thing was like a...momentary hiccup. Like the last time you guys fought.
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}一次都没有{/i}？可你们还住在一起吧？我以为求婚那事就像……一次小磕绊。就像你们上次吵架那样。

lines.en: : Yeah, hold on. You’re not breaking up just because Osako wants kids, are you? Because you might want them yourself one day, Wakana. You just don’t know it yet. That’s how I was when-
lines.zh: : 就是啊，等等。你们不会因为 Osako 想要孩子就分手吧？因为你自己说不定哪天也会想要，Wakana。你只是还没意识到。我当时就是——

lines.en: : I don’t {i}care{/i} how you were and I’m not interested in talking about this right now! We’re at fucking school! It’s entirely inappropriate!
lines.zh: : 我不{i}关心{/i}你当时怎样，而且我现在不想谈这个！我们可是在他妈的学校里！这完全不合适！

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene9
: You literally have a pair of handcuffs in your desk.
lines.zh: : 你办公桌里就明摆着一副手铐。

lines.en: : Why were you going through my desk?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么翻我桌子？！

lines.en: : I needed a stapler. How was I supposed to know I was going to wind up encountering a treasure trove of sex toys?
lines.zh: : 我需要订书机。我怎么知道会撞见一整个性玩具的宝库？

lines.en: : Assuming Wakana isn't actually just an undercover cop, you mean. You can never be too sure of that. I know from experience.
lines.zh: : 前提当然是 Wakana 不是卧底警察。这种事谁说得准。我有经验。

lines.en: : Also, you need a new pair of handcuffs. I may have taken those ones. And they may or may not be in the desk you’re sitting at right now. Don’t look.
lines.zh: : 还有，你需要一副新手铐。我可能把那副拿走了。而且它现在可能就在你坐着的那张桌子抽屉里。别看。

lines.en: : I’ll fuck you if you want, Wakana. That’s what friends are for, yeah?
lines.zh: : 你要是想要，我可以跟你上床，Wakana。朋友不就是干这个的吗？

lines.en: : No, Rika. I don’t think that’s what friends are for. Nor do I think Wakana wants to have sex with you when she probably just wants to fix stuff with Osako.
lines.zh: : 不，Rika。我觉得朋友不是干这个的。我也不觉得 Wakana 想跟你上床，她大概只想把跟 Osako 的事修好。

lines.en: : There is no {i}fixing{/i} this, Imani. I can’t give her what she needs and I have no intention of making her wait around on the off-chance that I suddenly and completely change.
lines.zh: : 这事{i}修{/i}不好了，Imani。我给不了她想要的东西，我也不打算让她干等着，赌我会突然彻底改变。

lines.en: : Which is why I humbly ask that the two of you stop talking about this. Because I am having an extremely tough time right now and there is nothing that can make it any better but time itself.
lines.zh: : 所以我恳求你俩别再谈这个了。因为我现在已经够难熬了，除了时间本身，没有什么能让它好一点。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene10
: Hey, maybe {i}you{/i} should try sleeping with Akira? That guy’s a dick-wizard. Maybe {i}he{/i} can make you feel better?
lines.zh: : 嘿，也许{i}你{/i}该试试跟 Akira 睡？那家伙是个鸡巴巫师。说不定能让你好受点？

lines.en: : “Dick wizard” probably isn’t the term I’d use, but I will absolutely admit that he can make pretty much any worry go away for a good thirty-to-sixty minutes at a time.
lines.zh: : 「鸡巴巫师」大概不是我会用的词，但我完全承认，他确实能让几乎任何烦恼消失个三十到六十分钟。

lines.en: : I think that time only goes up once you start involving more girls too because me and Imani took him on for at least three hours. Go team.
lines.zh: : 我觉得人一多时间还会更长，因为我和 Imani 两个人就耗了他至少三小时。干得漂亮。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene11
: Jesus fucking Christ! Do you two even {i}hear{/i} yourselves right now?! You’re speaking of him like he’s some kind of fucking toy!
lines.zh: : 我操他妈的耶稣基督！你俩{i}听见{/i}自己在说什么了吗？！你们把他当成了什么他妈的玩具！

lines.en: : I’m not going to sleep with him just to make myself feel better! And neither should you if that’s what you’ve been doing!
lines.zh: : 我不会为了让自己好受去跟他睡！你们要是这么干过，也不该！

lines.en: : Hey, as a reminder, I’m kind of in love with the guy. So maybe don’t lump me in with Rika here.
lines.zh: : 嘿，提醒一下，我可是有点爱那家伙的。所以别把我和 Rika 归为一类。

lines.en: : I don’t think Akira’s a toy, Wakana. I’m just saying that sleeping with him might make you feel a little better and that he definitely wouldn’t say no to you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Akira 不是玩具，Wakana。我只是说跟他睡也许能让你好受一点，而且他绝对不会拒绝你。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s much better, Rika.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这也好不到哪儿去，Rika。

lines.en: : It’s not! That’s basically the same fucking thing!
lines.zh: : 当然好不到哪去！这他妈基本就是一回事！

lines.en: : Oh.
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : What do you mean “why?!” It’s still {i}using{/i} him! And after all he’s been through in life, that’s the {i}last{/i} thing we should be doing!
lines.zh: : 「为什么」是什么意思？！那还是在{i}利用{/i}他！他这辈子经历了那么多，我们{i}最不该{/i}做的就是这种事！

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene12
: I mean...is it really {i}using{/i} him if you like him, though? Because you definitely do, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 我是说……如果你喜欢他，那还算{i}利用{/i}吗？因为你确实喜欢他，不是吗？

lines.en: : What? No I don’t. What are you talking about? He’s just a friend.
lines.zh: : 什么？我不喜欢。你在说什么？他只是个朋友。

lines.en: : I called it the first time I saw you two together, didn’t I? There’s some {i}crazy{/i} sexual tension there.
lines.zh: : 我第一次见你俩在一起时就说了，对吧？你们之间有股{i}疯狂{/i}的性张力。

lines.en: : There’s no tension there at all! Imani, tell her.
lines.zh: : 一点张力都没有！Imani，你告诉她。

lines.en: : Without beating around the bush, I consider you my greatest rival of all and often feel extremely inferior after seeing the two of you together. There’s tension, alright.
lines.zh: : 不绕弯子地说，我这辈子最大的对手就是你，每次看到你俩在一起我都觉得自己差得要命。是有张力，没错。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene13
: There’s no tension! I was and still technically {i}am{/i} in an extremely dedicated and loyal relationship until it’s otherwise stated!
lines.zh: : 没有张力！在正式说清楚之前，我{i}依然{/i}处在一段极其投入和忠诚的关系里！

lines.en: : I rest my case. Imani watches Akira like a hawk. If anyone’s going to know about sexual tension relating to him, it’s her.
lines.zh: : 我话说完了。Imani 盯着 Akira 盯得像只鹰。要说谁最懂跟他有关的性张力，那就是她。

lines.en: : Wakana, I’m not questioning your loyalty or dedication. I don’t think you’d ever, like...{i}cheat{/i} on Osako or anything.
lines.zh: : Wakana，我不是在质疑你的忠诚和投入。我不觉得你会……{i}背叛{/i} Osako 什么的。

lines.en: : But you’re seriously not going to pretend you’ve never even {i}fantasized{/i} about Senpai, are you?
lines.zh: : 但你该不会真要装作从没对前辈{i}幻想{/i}过吧？

lines.en: : It’s not pretending! It’s the truth!
lines.zh: : 不是装！是事实！

lines.en: : Girl, your eyes were {i}glued{/i} to him during our crazy beach sex night.
lines.zh: : 姑娘，那次疯狂的海滩性爱之夜，你的眼睛就{i}黏{/i}在他身上了。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene14
: They were not! You’re just making things up at this point!
lines.zh: : 才没有！你现在纯属编造！

lines.en: : I wish. And maybe {i}you{/i} just haven’t realized it yet, but there’s no way you see him as {i}just a friend.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我希望是。也许{i}你{/i}还没意识到，但你不可能{i}只{/i}把他当朋友。

lines.en: : Like, crazy horrible shit happened to {i}me{/i} when I was younger and you didn’t obsess over it for months. But you did with Akira because there’s something more there.
lines.zh: : 就好比，{i}我{/i}小时候遇到过很糟很糟的事，你并没有为此纠结好几个月。可你为 Akira 纠结了，因为你们之间不止于此。

lines.en: : And ignoring how upset I still am over not being included in the crazy beach sex night, I don’t see what good it does to lie to yourself now, Wakana. It was just an idea. You don’t need to get mad.
lines.zh: : 先不管我到现在还在为没被叫去参加那场疯狂海滩性爱之夜而生气——Wakana，现在骗自己有什么好处呢？只是个提议而已。你不必生气。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene15
: An idea predicated on me pulling the plug on the most important connection I have ever forged to find solace in the physical comfort of my closest confidant.
lines.zh: : 一个建立在我亲手拔掉此生最重要的那根连接、转而去最信任的人身上找肉体安慰的提议。

lines.en: : It matters not how I look at him or what my {i}fantasies{/i} may be. What matters is that you’d even {i}suggest{/i} such a thing like it’s some sort of {i}whim{/i} meant to be capitalized on.
lines.zh: : 我怎么看他、我的{i}幻想{/i}是什么，都不重要。重要的是你居然会{i}提出{/i}这种事，好像它是某种可以拿来利用的{i}一时冲动{/i}。

lines.en: : And to sit here and listen to the two of you speak about someone I care deeply for in this way only adds to the many frustrations I am currently feeling. Do you understand now?
lines.zh: : 而坐在这里听你俩这样谈论一个我很在乎的人，只会给我现在这堆烦心事再添一层。现在你们懂了吗？

lines.en: : Yes.

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene16
: Having sex with Arakawa will not fix anything, Rika. In fact, sex as a {i}whole{/i} can not fix anything. It’s just a bandage for a bullet hole.

lines.en: : I don’t know. I feel kind of great now and all {i}I{/i} really did was fuck him.

lines.en: : That’s because you are a very special girl who likely doesn’t understand what she’s {i}actually{/i} feeling yet.

lines.en: : And again, Osako and I are not formally separated at the moment. We’re just...on the cusp of that inevitable fate. Again. In a more...serious way this time.

: What?

lines.en: : What?

lines.en: : I can not fathom how such a thing would be helpful right now when Osako and I don’t exactly {i}want{/i} to sleep together given the uncertain nature of our existence as a couple and all.
lines.zh: : 我想不通这有什么用——Osako 和我现在根本{i}不想{/i}睡在一起，毕竟我们作为一对的未来还悬着呢。

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene18
: Not me! I don’t get {i}anything!{/i} Why do I have to be the odd one out?!
lines.zh: : 我没有！我{i}什么{/i}都没捞着！为什么我非得当那个落单的？！

lines.en: : Imani, Osako is an experienced lesbian. You simply won’t be able to please her the way I can. And if we’re doing this for Wakana’s future, we need to seriously consider things like that.
lines.zh: : Imani，Osako 是经验丰富的女同性恋。你根本没法像我那样让她满足。既然我们是为了 Wakana 的未来，这种事就得认真考虑。

lines.en: : And how exactly will watching the love of my life get tongued down by a mutual friend benefit my future?

: Season 8. Jim winds up sharing a hotel room with a temp named Cathy during a business trip while Pam was away.

lines.en: : But Jim, despite the temptation, remains loyal to his wife and resists the seductress, further reinforcing his love for Pam and propelling them to the future!

lines.zh: : 这对我有什么帮助？

lines.en: scene wakanaofficescene21
: Think about it. If you and Osako can {i}both{/i} resist the temptation of being alone in a room with someone you’re attracted to for the night, it’ll reinforce your love for {i}each other!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Or{/i} one or both of you will fail and then realize it isn’t meant to be. It’s an extremely simple test, all things considered.
lines.zh: : {i}或{/i}者你俩其中一个、甚至两个都失败，然后发现这事本来就不该成。总而言之，这是个极其简单的测试。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, your “test” assumes that Osako is attracted to you and would be tempted by your seduction {i}at all.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可惜，你这个「测试」的前提是 Osako 对你有感觉、并且会被你的勾引诱惑。

lines.en: : Do not underestimate my seduction skills, Wakana. I could have any of you at any moment. The only reason I haven’t yet is because I’m polite.

lines.en: : If she {i}isn’t{/i} though, and {i}you’re{/i} not attracted to Senpai either, don’t you think Rika’s plan might actually, and I can’t believe I’m saying this, {i}work?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可如果她{i}没有{/i}呢，而{i}你{/i}又对前辈没感觉，你不觉得 Rika 的计划也许真的——我真不敢相信自己会说这个——{i}行得通{/i}吗？
